contract_rule: Each representative week actual route flow equals its fixed weekly contract
distance_scope: Hydrogen pipeline route distance used for both cost and transport carbon

cost_curve.description: 基于图表33管道输送氢气成本曲线
cost_curve.notes:
成本函数已包含以下所有费用：
- 管道建设投资摊销 (Pipeline construction amortization)
- 压缩机站投资和运营 (Compressor station CAPEX & OPEX)
- 管道维护和检测 (Pipeline maintenance & inspection)
- 能耗成本（压缩机电力） (Energy cost for compression)
- 人工和管理成本 (Labor & management)

单位转换说明：
- 配置单位：元/(kg氢气·百公里)
- 计算公式：总成本 = 单位成本 × (运输距离km ÷ 100)
- 最终单位：元/kg氢气
- 与罐车运输单位保持一致
